scene: a fixed close shot of a small round pressure gauge on the underside of a wall boiler, the white dial dirty at the rim, the needle sitting just under one in the red band and shivering very slightly, a copper pipe and a grey plastic lever in the frame, cupboard light from one side and a cardboard box edge at the bottom

a fixed shot of flat canal water at dusk from the towpath, the first rain of a shower arriving so that single rings spread and multiply until the whole surface is broken, the reflection of a brick wall and one lit window coming apart in it, a mooring ring and wet stone in the bottom corner, low grey blue light
